flags.sentence: Behind a service that lets people ask AI to make phone calls, humans were actually making the calls.
flags.question: “humans were actually making the calls”は、台帳の「電話の一部を人間が担当した」より対象範囲を広く読める文ではありませんか。

flags.sentence: And if this was not properly explained, users had no way to know whether they were talking to AI or a person.
flags.question: “users had no way to know”は、台帳の「適切な開示なし」より強く、ユーザーが知る手段はなかったと断定している文ではありませんか。

flags.sentence: They were enjoying the convenience of AI, only to find a human on the other end of the call without realizing it.
flags.question: “without realizing it”は、台帳で確認できる「適切な開示がなかった」から、ユーザーが実際に気づかなかったと断定している文ではありませんか。

flags.sentence: News reports also cited an employee’s report that human staff made inappropriate comments about race during calls to negotiate internet or cable fees.
flags.question: “during calls”は、台帳の「1件の従業員報告として紹介された個別事例」より複数の電話で起きたように読める文ではありませんか。

flags.sentence: The company also restored the human concierge feature to the way it had been before, at least for now.
flags.question: “restored the human concierge feature”は、台帳の「人間コンシェルジュ機能をロールバックした」と逆に、機能を再開したように読める文ではありませんか。
